name: WorkBuddy Switch Next icon v5
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one bold redesigned app icon for WorkBuddy Switch Next, based on the PROVIDED ORIGINAL CAT. User direction: radically redesign it, but viewers must recognize THIS SPECIFIC CAT, and the letter N must be a strong intrinsic part of the design. Preserve the original mascot identity cues: mint/jade-green soft cat, two cobalt-blue oval/dot eyes, its tiny blue w-shaped smile, asymmetrical pointed ears, playful curled tail, and a cobalt-blue accent on the right ear. NEW CORE DESIGN: an elegant CAT-SHAPED CAPITAL N MONOGRAM. The silhouette reads clearly as a capital N even at small size, while also being this cat. Build the N from two thick softly rounded upright forms joined by a broad diagonal rising from bottom-left toward top-right. The mint-green left upright is the cat's compact rounded head and upper body with two unmistakable ears and original face looking forward. The cobalt-blue right upright and sweeping diagonal are ONE continuous thick curled cat tail rising behind and to the right of its head; the tail joins naturally into the lower body, so it is anatomically stylized but coherent. Two generous clean ivory negative spaces make the N structure legible. The head must be prominent and friendly rather than a tiny decorative appendage to a letter. Make the N unmistakable, not an H, M, Z, lightning bolt, or just a generic cat with an N printed on it. Harmonious solid mint green and saturated cobalt blue color blocking, refined soft matte tactile finish with very subtle volume. Clean premium software mascot identity with a strong readable silhouette. Warm pale ivory full-bleed square background. Center the COMPLETE mark with generous margins, no cropping. No separate text, no standalone letter printed on the face or chest, no badges, no arrows, no chevrons, no border or app tile within the canvas, no dark background, no accessories, no tiny decorations, no glossy plastic, no heavy shadow. Deliver a single polished square icon, no mockup, no presentation sheet.
integration: Cat-shaped N monogram candidate; application icons have not been replaced.
